using System.Text.Json;
using Hashbrown.AspNetCore;
using Npgsql;

static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(message); }
static string Request(string thread, string messages = "[{\"id\":\"u1\",\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"hello\"}]") => $"{{\"threadId\":\"{thread}\",\"runId\":\"untrusted\",\"messages\":{messages},\"tools\":[]}}";
static JsonElement Json(string json) => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(json);
static NativeSessionKey Key(string selector, string scope = "alice", string agent = "agent", string partition = "value") => new(agent, scope, selector, new Dictionary<string,string> { ["tenant"] = partition });
var mutableCalls = new List<NativeToolCall> { new("immutable", "server", 1, Json("{}")) };
var immutableSnapshot = new NativeSessionSnapshot("{}", Request("immutable"), mutableCalls, new List<string> { "browser" }, false);
mutableCalls.Clear();
Check(immutableSnapshot.PendingCalls.Count == 1, "Snapshot must own immutable cloned collections.");
await using var source = NpgsqlDataSource.Create(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DOTNET_TEST_POSTGRES") ?? throw new Exception("Real PostgreSQL fixture is required."));
var schema = "native_probe_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
var catalog = new NativeToolCatalog([new("server", 1, Json("{\"type\":\"object\"}"))]);
var journal = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(source, catalog, "model-v1", schema);
try
{
    await journal.InitializeAsync();
    foreach (var malformed in new[]
    {
        "null", "[]", "42", "true", "{",
        """{"threadId":"malformed","messages":null}""",
        """{"threadId":"malformed","messages":[null]}""",
        """{"threadId":"malformed","messages":[{"id":"a","role":"assistant","toolCalls":[null]}]}""",
        """{"threadId":"malformed","messages":[{"id":"u","role":"user","content":"hi"}],"tools":[null]}""",
        """{"threadId":"malformed","messages":[{"id":"u","role":4,"content":"hi"}]}""",
        """{"threadId":"malformed","messages":[{"id":"a","role":"assistant","toolCalls":[{"id":"c","function":null}]}]}"""
    })
        Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(Key("malformed"), malformed)).Status == 400, "Malformed public JSON must return bad input before storage or execution.");
    // Actual published SDK callback inserts each browser result immediately after its assistant parent.
    var sdkCallback = ActualInterleavedBrowserCallback();
    var sdkRoot = System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse(sdkCallback)!.AsObject();
    var sdkKey = Key(sdkRoot["threadId"]!.GetValue<string>());
    var sdkPrefix = ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => RemoveMessages(root, message => message["role"]!.GetValue<string>() == "tool"));
    var sdkInitial = ChangeCallback(sdkPrefix, root => RemoveMessages(root, message => message["role"]!.GetValue<string>() == "assistant"));
    var sdkOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(sdkKey, sdkInitial)).Lease!;
    var sdkPrivateCall = new NativeToolCall("sdk-private-backend", "server", 1, Json("{\"value\":1}"));
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(sdkOwner, sdkPrivateCall), "Actual SDK setup must retain a model-captured private backend descriptor.");
    var sdkSaved = await journal.SaveAsync(sdkOwner, new("{}", sdkPrefix, [sdkPrivateCall], ["browser-one", "browser-two"], false));
    Check(sdkSaved is not null && await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(sdkSaved) && await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(sdkSaved), "Actual SDK first public prefix must publish before results are admitted.");

    var sdkAdmitted = await journal.TryAcquireAsync(sdkKey, sdkCallback);
    Check(sdkAdmitted.Status == 200 && sdkAdmitted.Snapshot!.PendingCalls.Single().Id == sdkPrivateCall.Id, "Actual SDK two-assistant interleaved callback must restore private server authority unchanged.");
    Check((await journal.GetOwnedCallAsync(sdkAdmitted.Lease!, sdkPrivateCall.Id))!.Arguments.GetRawText() == sdkPrivateCall.Arguments.GetRawText(), "Browser result insertion must not alter stored server arguments.");
    Check(await journal.FailureCleanupAsync(sdkAdmitted.Lease!), "Read-only callback regression must release its current pre-effect owner.");

    var sdkStored = new NativeSessionSnapshot("{}", NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(sdkPrefix, sdkKey, catalog, new()), [sdkPrivateCall], ["browser-one", "browser-two"], false);
    bool AdmitsSdk(string candidate, NativeSessionSnapshot? snapshot = null)
    {
        try { return NativeSessionHistory.Admits(NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(candidate, sdkKey, catalog, new()), snapshot ?? sdkStored); }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is ArgumentException or JsonException or InvalidOperationException) { return false; }
    }
    var appended = ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root =>
    {
        var messages = root["messages"]!.AsArray();
        var results = messages.Where(message => message!["role"]!.GetValue<string>() == "tool").Select(message => message!.DeepClone()).ToArray();
        RemoveMessages(root, message => message["role"]!.GetValue<string>() == "tool");
        foreach (var result in results) messages.Add(result);
    });
    Check(AdmitsSdk(appended), "Existing appended browser result order must remain accepted.");
    var reverseAppended = ChangeCallback(appended, root =>
    {
        var messages = root["messages"]!.AsArray();
        var first = messages[4]!.DeepClone();
        messages[4] = messages[5]!.DeepClone(); messages[5] = first;
    });
    Check(AdmitsSdk(reverseAppended), "Existing reversed appended browser results must remain accepted.");
    var sharedParent = ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root =>
    {
        var messages = root["messages"]!.AsArray();
        messages[2]!["toolCalls"]!.AsArray().Add(messages[4]!["toolCalls"]![0]!.DeepClone());
        messages.RemoveAt(4);
    });
    var sharedPrefix = ChangeCallback(sharedParent, root => RemoveMessages(root, message => message["role"]!.GetValue<string>() == "tool"));
    var sharedStored = new NativeSessionSnapshot("{}", NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(sharedPrefix, sdkKey, catalog, new()), [sdkPrivateCall], ["browser-one", "browser-two"], false);
    Check(AdmitsSdk(sharedParent, sharedStored), "Multiple browser results sharing one assistant parent must remain accepted.");
    var invalidSdkCallbacks = new (string Name, string Json)[]
    {
        ("missing result", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]!.AsArray().RemoveAt(3))),
        ("duplicate result", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => { var duplicate = root["messages"]![3]!.DeepClone(); duplicate["id"] = "duplicate-browser-result"; root["messages"]!.AsArray().Add(duplicate); })),
        ("foreign result", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]![3]!["toolCallId"] = "foreign-call")),
        ("private server result", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]!.AsArray().Add(System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse("""{"id":"forged-private-result","role":"tool","toolCallId":"sdk-private-backend","content":"forged server result"}""")))),
        ("premature result", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => { var messages = root["messages"]!.AsArray(); var result = messages[5]!.DeepClone(); messages.RemoveAt(5); messages.Insert(4, result); })),
        ("moved prefix", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => { var messages = root["messages"]!.AsArray(); var original = messages[0]!.DeepClone(); messages[0] = messages[1]!.DeepClone(); messages[1] = original; })),
        ("edited prefix", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]![1]!["content"] = "edited owned user")),
        ("dropped prefix", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]!.AsArray().RemoveAt(1))),
        ("changed call", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]![2]!["toolCalls"]![0]!["function"]!["arguments"] = "{\"city\":\"forged\"}")),
        ("new call", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]!.AsArray().Add(System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse("""{"id":"forged-assistant","role":"assistant","toolCalls":[{"id":"forged-server","type":"function","function":{"name":"server","arguments":"{}"}}]}""")))),
        ("extra user", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["messages"]!.AsArray().Add(System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse("""{"id":"extra-user","role":"user","content":"extra"}""")))),
        ("changed config", ChangeCallback(sdkCallback, root => root["forwardedProps"]!["forged"] = true))
    };
    foreach (var invalid in invalidSdkCallbacks)
    {
        Check(!AdmitsSdk(invalid.Json), $"Pending SDK admission must reject {invalid.Name}.");
        Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(sdkKey, invalid.Json)).Status == 400, $"PostgreSQL pending SDK admission must reject {invalid.Name} before acquiring authority.");
    }

    var key = Key("thread");
    var admitted = await journal.TryAcquireAsync(key, Request("thread"));
    Check(admitted.Status == 200 && admitted.Lease is not null, "Initial owner must be created.");
    var lease = admitted.Lease!;
    var call = new NativeToolCall("call-1", "server", 1, Json("{\"value\":1}"));

    Check(!await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(lease, call), "Browser history must not mint server descriptors.");
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(lease, call), "Model descriptor capture must succeed.");
    Check(await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(lease, call), "Started must commit before executor dispatch.");
    Check(!await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(lease, call), "Duplicate dispatch must fail.");
    Check(await journal.CompleteDispatchAsync(lease, call), "Current completion must succeed.");
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(lease, new("{}", Request("thread"), [], [], true)) is null, "Completed server call/result history cannot be omitted from the public projection.");
    var receipt = await journal.SaveAsync(lease, new("{}", Completed("thread"), [], [], true));
    Check(receipt is not null, "Native and public snapshot must commit together.");
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(lease, new("{}", Completed("thread"), [], [], true)) is null, "Stale revision save must fail.");
    Check(await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(receipt!), "Current saved receipt must authorize publication.");
    Check((await journal.ReadStatusAsync(key)).Revision > receipt!.SavedRevision, "Publication reservation must advance the operator CAS revision.");
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(key, Request("thread"))).Status == 409, "Publishing must block competing owners.");
    Check(await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(receipt!), "Current publication finalization must succeed.");
    var numericKey = Key("numeric");
    var numericPrefix = NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(Mixed("numeric", true, false), numericKey, catalog, new());
    var numericIncoming = System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse(Mixed("numeric", true, true))!;
    numericIncoming["messages"]![1]!["toolCalls"]![0]!["function"]!["arguments"] = "{\"value\":1.0}";
    Check(NativeSessionHistory.Admits(NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(numericIncoming.ToJsonString(), numericKey, catalog, new()), new("{}", numericPrefix, [call], ["browser-call"], false)), "Equivalent JSON number arguments must survive browser canonicalization.");

    // Scope, agent and every native partition are independent authority boundaries.
    foreach (var isolated in new[] { Key("thread", "bob"), Key("thread", agent: "other"), Key("thread", partition: "other") })
        Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(isolated, Request("thread"))).Status == 200, "All native partitions must be preserved.");
    var incompatible = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(source, catalog, "model-v2", schema);
    Check((await incompatible.TryAcquireAsync(key, Request("thread"))).Status == 409, "Model identity changes must conflict on the same selector.");
    var changedCatalog = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(source, new NativeToolCatalog([new("server", 2, Json("{\"type\":\"object\"}"))]), "model-v1", schema);
    Check((await changedCatalog.TryAcquireAsync(key, Request("thread"))).Status == 409, "Catalog changes must not allocate fresh authority.");
    await Task.WhenAll(Enumerable.Range(0, 4).Select(_ => journal.InitializeAsync().AsTask()));

    var simultaneous = await Task.WhenAll(Enumerable.Range(0, 8).Select(_ => journal.TryAcquireAsync(Key("race"), Request("race")).AsTask()));
    Check(simultaneous.Count(result => result.Status == 200) == 1 && simultaneous.Count(result => result.Status == 409) == 7, "Concurrent first allocation must establish exactly one owner.");

    // SQL expiry is deterministic: no elapsed sleeps are used to establish authority.
    var takeoverKey = Key("takeover");
    var before = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(takeoverKey, Request("takeover"))).Lease!;
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", takeoverKey.Id);
    var afterAdmission = await journal.TryAcquireAsync(takeoverKey, Request("takeover"));
    var after = afterAdmission.Lease!;
    Check(afterAdmission.Status == 200 && after.Generation > before.Generation && afterAdmission.IsNew, "Pre-effect takeover may safely retry a known virgin.");
    Check(!await journal.RenewAsync(before) && !await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(before, call) && !await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(before, call) && !await journal.CompleteDispatchAsync(before, call) && !await journal.FailureCleanupAsync(before), "Every callback must independently reject a stale generation.");
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(before, new("{}", Request("takeover"), [], [], true)) is null, "Stale save must fail after takeover.");
    Check(await journal.FailureCleanupAsync(after), "Current pre-effect cleanup must release ownership.");

    var unknownKey = Key("unknown");
    var unknown = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(unknownKey, Request("unknown"))).Lease!;
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(unknown, call) && await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(unknown, call), "Ambiguity setup must commit Started.");
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", unknownKey.Id);
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(unknownKey, Request("unknown"))).Status == 409, "Abandoned Started must never be taken over automatically.");
    var inspection = (await journal.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "alice" }, unknownKey))!;
    Check(inspection.Status.State == "Blocked" && inspection.Invocations.Single().State == "Started", "Unknown dispatch must remain fenced.");
    var reconcile = new NativeSessionReconciliation(inspection.Status.State!, inspection.Status.Generation, inspection.Status.Revision, "ConfirmedNotPerformed", "external executor inspected", "fixture-evidence", true);
    Check(await journal.ReconcileAsync(new HashSet<string> { "bob" }, unknownKey, "operator", reconcile) == 404, "Operators must be scope-restricted.");
    Check(await journal.ReconcileAsync(new HashSet<string> { "alice" }, unknownKey, "operator", reconcile with { ExternalQuiescenceAcknowledged = false }) == 400, "Operator evidence requires explicit quiescence.");
    Check(await journal.ReconcileAsync(new HashSet<string> { "alice" }, unknownKey, "operator", reconcile with { ExpectedRevision = 0 }) == 409, "Reconciliation must compare exact revision.");
    Check(await journal.ReconcileAsync(new HashSet<string> { "alice" }, unknownKey, "operator", reconcile) == 200, "Scoped reconciler must terminally retire authority.");
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(unknownKey, Request("unknown"))).Status == 410 && !await journal.CompleteDispatchAsync(unknown, call), "Reconciliation never reopens the selector or accepts late completion.");
    Check((await journal.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "alice" }, unknownKey))!.Audit.Count == 1, "Reconciliation evidence must remain immutable.");

    var savedKey = Key("saved");
    var savedLease = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(savedKey, Request("saved"))).Lease!;
    var saved = (await journal.SaveAsync(savedLease, new("{}", Request("saved"), [], [], true)))!;
    Check(await journal.RenewAsync(savedLease) && await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(saved), "Heartbeat after save must preserve the receipt.");
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", savedKey.Id);
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(savedKey, Request("saved"))).Status == 409 && !await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(saved), "Expired Publishing must block all takeover and stale finalization.");
    Check(await journal.RetireAsync(new HashSet<string> { "alice" }, savedKey, "operator", new("Publishing", savedLease.Generation, saved.SavedRevision + 1, "Retired", "publisher stopped", "fixture-evidence", true)) == 200, "Quiescent publication may be terminally retired.");
    Check(!await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(saved) && !await journal.FailureCleanupAsync(savedLease), "Old publisher cannot overwrite retirement.");

    var unpublishedKey = Key("unpublished");
    var unpublishedOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(unpublishedKey, Request("unpublished"))).Lease!;
    var unpublishedReceipt = (await journal.SaveAsync(unpublishedOwner, new("{}", Request("unpublished"), [], [], true)))!;
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", unpublishedKey.Id);
    var nextUser = Request("unpublished", "[{\"id\":\"u1\",\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"hello\"},{\"id\":\"u2\",\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"next\"}]");
    var replacement = await journal.TryAcquireAsync(unpublishedKey, nextUser);
    Check(replacement.Status == 200 && !replacement.IsNew, "Expired saved-but-unpublished owner may be replaced from valid durable state.");
    Check(!await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(unpublishedReceipt) && !await journal.FailureCleanupAsync(unpublishedOwner), "Older saved receipt and cleanup must lose authority after replacement.");
    Check(await journal.FailureCleanupAsync(replacement.Lease!), "Pre-dispatch replacement cleanup may release its request.");

    var statusExpiredKey = Key("status-expired");
    var statusExpiredOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(statusExpiredKey, Request("status-expired"))).Lease!;
    var statusExpiredReceipt = (await journal.SaveAsync(statusExpiredOwner, new("{}", Request("status-expired"), [], [], true)))!;
    Check(await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(statusExpiredReceipt) && await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(statusExpiredReceipt), "Expiry status setup must publish.");
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", statusExpiredKey.Id);
    Check((await journal.ReadStatusAsync(statusExpiredKey)).PublicRequest is null, "Expired private history must be unavailable even before maintenance.");

    // Expiry/deletion preserve selector tombstones, including zero-effect sessions.
    var expiredKey = Key("expired");
    _ = await journal.TryAcquireAsync(expiredKey, Request("expired"));
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", expiredKey.Id);
    Check(await journal.MaintainAsync() >= 1, "Maintenance must purge expired private state.");
    await journal.MaintainAsync();
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(expiredKey, Request("expired"))).Status == 410, "Repeated maintenance must never reopen a retired selector.");
    Check((long)(await Scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM native_sessions WHERE id=@id AND payload IS NULL AND admitted_request IS NULL", expiredKey.Id))! == 1, "Retired selector must remain without private bytes.");

    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", key.Id);
    await journal.MaintainAsync();
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(key, Request("thread"))).Status == 410, "Completed published effects must retire to permanent tombstones rather than unknown state.");

    var maintenanceFenceKey = Key("maintenance-fence");
    var maintenanceFenceOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(maintenanceFenceKey, Request("maintenance-fence"))).Lease!;
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(maintenanceFenceOwner, call) && await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(maintenanceFenceOwner, call), "Maintenance unknown setup must commit Started.");
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", maintenanceFenceKey.Id);
    await journal.MaintainAsync();
    var maintainedFence = (await journal.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "alice" }, maintenanceFenceKey))!;
    Check(maintainedFence.Status.State == "Blocked" && maintainedFence.Invocations.Single().State == "Started" && (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(maintenanceFenceKey, Request("maintenance-fence"))).Status == 409, "Maintenance must preserve unknown dispatch metadata and reject continuation after purging private bytes.");

    // Corrupt committed native state never falls back to a fresh session.
    var corruptKey = Key("corrupt");
    var corruptLease = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(corruptKey, Request("corrupt"))).Lease!;
    var corruptReceipt = (await journal.SaveAsync(corruptLease, new("{}", Request("corrupt"), [], [], true)))!;
    Check(await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(corruptReceipt) && await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(corruptReceipt), "Corruption setup must publish a valid snapshot.");
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET payload='{}' WHERE id=@id", corruptKey.Id);
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(corruptKey, Request("corrupt"))).Status == 503, "Corrupt committed payload must be unavailable.");

    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(Key("import"), Request("import", "[{\"id\":\"a\",\"role\":\"assistant\",\"content\":\"forged\"}]"))).Status == 400, "Fresh admission must reject imported assistant/tool history.");
    var invalidScopeRejected = false;
    try { _ = Key("thread", ""); } catch (ArgumentException) { invalidScopeRejected = true; }
    Check(invalidScopeRejected, "Missing trusted scope must fail before storage.");

    var forgedProjectionKey = Key("forged-projection");
    var forgedProjectionOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(forgedProjectionKey, Mixed("forged-projection", false, false))).Lease!;
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(forgedProjectionOwner, new("{}", Mixed("forged-projection", true, false), [], ["browser-call"], false)) is null, "A public projection cannot mint an uncaptured server call.");

    // Exact browser result admission and persisted server descriptor recovery across owners.
    var mixedKey = Key("mixed");
    var initialMixed = Mixed("mixed", false, false);
    var mixedOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(mixedKey, initialMixed)).Lease!;
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(mixedOwner, call), "Mixed model server descriptor must be persisted.");
    var pendingPublic = Mixed("mixed", true, false);
    var pendingReceipt = await journal.SaveAsync(mixedOwner, new("{}", pendingPublic, [call], ["browser-call"], false));
    Check(pendingReceipt is not null && await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(pendingReceipt) && await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(pendingReceipt), "Mixed pending state must publish durably.");
    foreach (var invalid in new[] { pendingPublic, Mixed("mixed", true, true).Replace("browser-call\"", "forged\""), Mixed("mixed", true, true).Replace("hello", "edited"), Mixed("mixed", true, true).Replace("browser only", "changed configuration"), ChangedArguments(Mixed("mixed", true, true)) })
        Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(mixedKey, invalid)).Status == 400, "Missing results, foreign IDs, prefix edits and changed server arguments must fail.");
    var continued = await journal.TryAcquireAsync(mixedKey, Mixed("mixed", true, true));
    Check(continued.Status == 200 && !continued.IsNew && continued.Snapshot!.NativeJson == "{}", "Another owner must restore pending native state with exact browser results.");
    Check(!await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(continued.Lease!, new("browser-call", "server", 1, Json("{}"))), "A model server descriptor cannot reuse an owned historical browser call ID.");
    var storedCall = await journal.GetOwnedCallAsync(continued.Lease!, call.Id);
    Check(storedCall is not null && await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(continued.Lease!, storedCall), "Restored descriptor must authorize one native dispatch.");
    Check(!await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(continued.Lease!, new("call-1", "server", 1, Json("{\"value\":2}"))), "Changed captured descriptor must fail.");
    Check(await journal.FailureCleanupAsync(continued.Lease!), "Failed post-dispatch work must retain a blocked fence.");
    Check((await journal.TryAcquireAsync(mixedKey, Mixed("mixed", true, true))).Status == 409, "Post-dispatch cleanup must never release authority for retry.");

    // Pinned native bypass emits only the browser call first; backend descriptors stay private until continuation.
    var hiddenKey = Key("hidden-native");
    var hiddenOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(hiddenKey, Mixed("hidden-native", false, false))).Lease!;
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(hiddenOwner, call), "Hidden native backend descriptor must be model-captured before bypass.");
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(hiddenOwner, new("{}", FrontendOnly("hidden-native", false), [], ["browser-call"], false)) is null, "Private pending descriptors cannot be omitted from durable save.");
    var hiddenReceipt = await journal.SaveAsync(hiddenOwner, new("{}", FrontendOnly("hidden-native", false), [call], ["browser-call"], false));
    Check(hiddenReceipt is not null && await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(hiddenReceipt) && await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(hiddenReceipt), "Native frontend-only first response must durably retain its hidden server descriptor.");
    var hiddenContinuation = await journal.TryAcquireAsync(hiddenKey, FrontendOnly("hidden-native", true));
    Check(hiddenContinuation.Status == 200 && hiddenContinuation.Snapshot!.PendingCalls.Single().Id == call.Id, "Exact browser results must restore private native backend authority.");
    var hiddenCall = (await journal.GetOwnedCallAsync(hiddenContinuation.Lease!, call.Id))!;
    Check(await journal.TryStartDispatchAsync(hiddenContinuation.Lease!, hiddenCall) && await journal.CompleteDispatchAsync(hiddenContinuation.Lease!, hiddenCall), "Hidden descriptor may execute once through restored native invocation.");
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(hiddenContinuation.Lease!, new("{}", FrontendOnly("hidden-native", true), [], [], true)) is null, "Completed hidden backend must become visible with its result before durable completion.");
    var hiddenCompleted = await journal.SaveAsync(hiddenContinuation.Lease!, new("{}", DeferredCompleted("hidden-native"), [], [], true));
    Check(hiddenCompleted is not null && await journal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(hiddenCompleted) && await journal.FinalizePublicationAsync(hiddenCompleted), "Genuine deferred call/result history must publish after completion.");

    var orphanKey = Key("orphan-hidden");
    var orphanOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(orphanKey, Request("orphan-hidden"))).Lease!;
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(orphanOwner, call), "Orphan hidden setup must capture a real model descriptor.");
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(orphanOwner, new("{}", Request("orphan-hidden"), [call], [], false)) is null, "Unexplained hidden backend state without visible browser work must fail closed.");
    var collisionKey = Key("hidden-collision");
    var collisionOwner = (await journal.TryAcquireAsync(collisionKey, Mixed("hidden-collision", false, false))).Lease!;
    var collisionCall = new NativeToolCall("browser-call", "server", 1, Json("{}"));
    Check(await journal.CaptureModelCallAsync(collisionOwner, collisionCall), "Same-response collision must be detected before publication or dispatch.");
    Check(await journal.SaveAsync(collisionOwner, new("{}", FrontendOnly("hidden-collision", false), [collisionCall], ["browser-call"], false)) is null, "Private server IDs cannot alias visible browser call IDs.");

    // Independent payload and selector capacity, including permanent tombstones.
    var limited = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(source, catalog, "model-v1", schema, new() { PayloadCapacity = 1, SelectorCapacity = 2 });
    var capOne = Key("cap-one", "capacity");
    Check((await limited.TryAcquireAsync(capOne, Request("cap-one"))).Status == 200, "First payload must fit.");
    Check((await limited.TryAcquireAsync(Key("cap-two", "capacity"), Request("cap-two"))).Status == 503, "Payload capacity must reject before work.");
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", capOne.Id);
    await limited.MaintainAsync();
    Check((await limited.TryAcquireAsync(Key("cap-two", "capacity"), Request("cap-two"))).Status == 200, "Private-byte purge frees only payload capacity.");
    await Sql("UPDATE native_sessions SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=@id", Key("cap-two", "capacity").Id);
    await limited.MaintainAsync();
    Check((await limited.TryAcquireAsync(Key("cap-three", "capacity"), Request("cap-three"))).Status == 503 && (await limited.TryAcquireAsync(capOne, Request("cap-one"))).Status == 410, "Tombstones permanently consume metadata capacity and never reopen.");

    var atomicCapacity = await Task.WhenAll(Enumerable.Range(0, 4).Select(index => limited.TryAcquireAsync(Key($"atomic-{index}", "atomic-capacity"), Request($"atomic-{index}")).AsTask()));
    Check(atomicCapacity.Count(result => result.Status == 200) == 1 && atomicCapacity.Count(result => result.Status == 503) == 3, "Concurrent different selectors must atomically enforce per-scope capacity.");

    var tiny = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(source, catalog, "model-v1", schema, new() { NativeBytes = 2, PublicBytes = 4096, ArgumentBytes = 2, MaximumCalls = 1 });
    var tinyKey = Key("tiny");
    var tinyOwner = (await tiny.TryAcquireAsync(tinyKey, Request("tiny"))).Lease!;
    Check(await tiny.SaveAsync(tinyOwner, new("{\"oversized\":true}", Request("tiny"), [], [], true)) is null, "Oversized native state must fail without publication.");
    Check(!await tiny.CaptureModelCallAsync(tinyOwner, call), "Oversized arguments must fail before marker.");
    Check((await tiny.TryAcquireAsync(Key("oversized"), Request("oversized").Replace("hello", new string('x', 5000)))).Status == 400, "Oversized incoming transcript must fail before allocation.");

    // Existing real schema-three checkpoint rows and metadata are never migrated or rewritten.
    var checkpointRegistry = new WorkflowOperationRegistry([new("checkpoint", 1, _ => true, (_, _) => ValueTask.CompletedTask, (_, _, _) => ValueTask.CompletedTask)]);
    var checkpoints = new PostgresInterruptStore(source, checkpointRegistry, schema);
    await checkpoints.InitializeAsync();
    var checkpointInput = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(Request("checkpoint"), AGUI.Abstractions.AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput)!;
    var checkpoint = await checkpoints.CreateAsync("checkpoint-scope", checkpointInput, new("checkpoint", 1, Json("{}")));
    await journal.InitializeAsync();
    await using (var connection = await source.OpenConnectionAsync())
    {
        await using var verify = new NpgsqlCommand($"SELECT version FROM \"{schema}\".interrupt_metadata WHERE id=1", connection);
        Check((int)(await verify.ExecuteScalarAsync())! == 3, "Native initialization must preserve checkpoint version three.");
        await using var row = new NpgsqlCommand($"SELECT count(*) FROM \"{schema}\".interrupt_batches WHERE id=@id AND state='Pending'", connection);
        row.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", checkpoint.Id);
        Check((long)(await row.ExecuteScalarAsync())! == 1, "Native initialization must preserve actual schema-three checkpoint rows.");
        await using var future = new NpgsqlCommand($"UPDATE \"{schema}\".native_metadata SET version=3 WHERE id=1", connection);
        await future.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
        var rejectedFuture = false;
        try { await journal.InitializeAsync(); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { rejectedFuture = true; }
        Check(rejectedFuture, "Unknown native schema versions must be rejected.");
    }

    Console.WriteLine("Native session PostgreSQL contracts passed.");
}
finally
{
    await using var connection = await source.OpenConnectionAsync();
    await using var command = new NpgsqlCommand($"DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS \"{schema}\" CASCADE", connection);
    await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
}

async Task Sql(string sql, string id)
{
    await using var connection = await source.OpenConnectionAsync();
    await using var command = new NpgsqlCommand(sql.Replace("native_sessions", $"\"{schema}\".native_sessions"), connection);
    command.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", id);
    await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
}
async Task<object?> Scalar(string sql, string id)
{
    await using var connection = await source.OpenConnectionAsync();
    await using var command = new NpgsqlCommand(sql.Replace("native_sessions", $"\"{schema}\".native_sessions"), connection);
    command.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", id);
    return await command.ExecuteScalarAsync();
}

static string Mixed(string thread, bool calls, bool result)
{
    var messages = new List<object> { new { id = "u1", role = "user", content = "hello" } };
    if (calls) messages.Add(new { id = "a1", role = "assistant", toolCalls = new object[] { new { id = "call-1", type = "function", function = new { name = "server", arguments = "{\"value\":1}" } }, new { id = "browser-call", type = "function", function = new { name = "browser", arguments = "{}" } } } });
    if (result) messages.Add(new { id = "result", role = "tool", toolCallId = "browser-call", content = "browser-value" });
    return JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { threadId = thread, runId = "browser-selected", messages, tools = new[] { new { name = "browser", description = "browser only", parameters = Json("{\"type\":\"object\"}") } } });
}

static string ChangedArguments(string request)
{
    var root = System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse(request)!;
    root["messages"]![1]!["toolCalls"]![0]!["function"]!["arguments"] = "{\"value\":2}";
    return root.ToJsonString();
}

static string Completed(string thread) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
{
    threadId = thread, runId = "untrusted", tools = Array.Empty<object>(), messages = new object[]
    {
        new { id = "u1", role = "user", content = "hello" },
        new { id = "server-message", role = "assistant", toolCalls = new[] { new { id = "call-1", type = "function", function = new { name = "server", arguments = "{\"value\":1}" } } } },
        new { id = "server-result", role = "tool", toolCallId = "call-1", content = "server-value" }
    }
});

static string FrontendOnly(string thread, bool result)
{
    var root = System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse(Mixed(thread, true, result))!;
    root["messages"]![1]!["toolCalls"]!.AsArray().RemoveAt(0);
    return root.ToJsonString();
}
static string DeferredCompleted(string thread)
{
    var root = System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse(FrontendOnly(thread, true))!;
    var messages = root["messages"]!.AsArray();
    messages.Add(JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(new { id = "backend-message", role = "assistant", toolCalls = new[] { new { id = "call-1", type = "function", function = new { name = "server", arguments = "{\"value\":1}" } } } }));
    messages.Add(JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(new { id = "backend-result", role = "tool", toolCallId = "call-1", content = "server-value" }));
    return root.ToJsonString();
}

static string ActualInterleavedBrowserCallback() => """{"threadId":"e77146f5-ff36-40c1-be1f-69ef9800b622","runId":"51521cb9-85bf-430f-839f-a9b1710a1e8e","messages":[{"id":"90fdab04-39e3-46dd-8a04-996578e03662","role":"system","content":"Runtime smoke system prompt."},{"id":"23114f5f-a874-4f89-b8c4-03c4750f67c2","role":"user","content":"Native multiple-siblings"},{"id":"assistant-browser-one","role":"assistant","content":"","toolCalls":[{"id":"browser-one","type":"function","function":{"name":"getWeather","arguments":"{\"city\":\"Paris\"}"}}]},{"id":"936ebd1f-84d6-4c4f-8915-72a70a5302ef","role":"tool","toolCallId":"browser-one","content":"{\"city\":\"Paris\",\"temperatureC\":21,\"condition\":\"sunny\"}"},{"id":"assistant-browser-two","role":"assistant","content":"","toolCalls":[{"id":"browser-two","type":"function","function":{"name":"getWeather","arguments":"{\"city\":\"Portland\"}"}}]},{"id":"741829bc-12cd-4caf-8ab3-9a2dbed62733","role":"tool","toolCallId":"browser-two","content":"{\"city\":\"Portland\",\"temperatureC\":21,\"condition\":\"sunny\"}"}],"tools":[{"name":"getWeather","description":"Get the current weather for a city.","parameters":{"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string","description":"The city to get weather for"}},"required":["city"],"additionalProperties":false,"description":"Weather lookup"}}],"context":[],"forwardedProps":{}}""";
static string ChangeCallback(string request, Action<System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonObject> change)
{
    var root = System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode.Parse(request)!.AsObject();
    change(root);
    return root.ToJsonString();
}
static void RemoveMessages(System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonObject root, Func<System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode, bool> remove)
{
    var messages = root["messages"]!.AsArray();
    for (var index = messages.Count - 1; index >= 0; index--) if (remove(messages[index]!)) messages.RemoveAt(index);
}
